declienting: Renamed the export from PillTabs to Tabs (the canonical); the PillTabItem/PillTabsProps types became TabItem/TabsProps.

Added an uncontrolled mode (defaultActiveId, with activeId + onSelect as an optional controlled override), matching the library's Slider convention; the client component was controlled-only (required activeId/onSelect).

Mapped the client Tailwind utilities onto library semantic tokens: the selected segment bg-background-inverse/text-links-inverse became bg-surface-inverse/text-text-inverse, the unselected text-text-tertiary became text-text-secondary (the library has no tertiary text token) with hover text-text-primary, the pill radius rounded-(--radius-pill) became rounded-pill, and the client spacing gap-padding-4xs/px-padding-m/py-padding-xxs became gap-2xs/px-m/py-2xs.
Replaced the client font-family-body/text-ui-md typography utilities with the library's text-base — the library ships no client type scale.

Replaced the fixed duration-200 ease-out + motion-reduce:transition-none transition with duration-[var(--duration-base)] ease-standard, so reduced motion is handled by the token layer zeroing the duration rather than a per-component media query.

Kept verbatim: role=tablist/role=tab, aria-selected, the roving tabIndex (0 on the selected tab, -1 on the rest), the ArrowLeft/ArrowRight selection-and-focus loop with wraparound, and the items.length < 2 keyboard guard — the accessibility contract that made it worth capturing.
